main_text.p: propter cas quas à barbaris Europa clades accepe-[illegible, ~2 letters]rat, emiserit imperatorem exercitus Joannem, [illegible, ~3 letters]quem cognominabant Musto canonem, cum sub [illegible, ~2 letters]imperatore Droctone, qui etiam in obsidione Adria[illegible, ~3 letters] nopoleos ab Abaris facta commissus inter milites, [illegible, ~2 letters]urbem servavit. Continet etiam hic liber, quomodo [illegible, ~2 letters]Heraclius castellum Perficum vi capere fit ag-[illegible, ~3 letters]greffus, deque praesidio Beiudaës dicto, & quomodo [illegible, ~2 letters]mirabili fortitudine sapëris militis, praesidium ce-[illegible, ~2 letters]perint Romani & hinc tandem aduentum Philip-[illegible, ~2 letters]picii in urbem regiam.

Tertius autem liber differit, quomodo ele-[illegible, ~2 letters]ctus fit Philippici loco dux orientalis militiae Pris-[illegible, ~2 letters]cus, & quomodo Philippicus inuidiosus Prisco, ad [illegible, ~2 letters]Heraclium scripserit, cibaria exercitui diminuta es-[illegible, ~2 letters]se, quodque Priscus cum exercitum adcedat, non [illegible, ~2 letters]ex equo descédat è more veteri, atq; ita salutet mi-[illegible, ~2 letters]litem. quapropter cum miles, & quod cibaria sibi [illegible, ~2 letters]praecisa essent, & quod honore debito non fuisset [illegible, ~2 letters]compellatus, seditionem faceret, & Priscus accepta [illegible, ~2 letters]non manufacta imagine, per hanc exorare plebem [illegible, ~2 letters]constitueret illam quoq; lapidibus petierunt. Itaq; [illegible, ~2 letters]fuga recepit se Constantinam Priscus, & electus est [illegible, ~2 letters]ab exercitu futurus ei dux Germanus, licet inuitus. [illegible, ~2 letters]atq; hac obtinente discordia, non paucae Romanis [illegible, ~2 letters]calamitates à Persis sunt illatae. quapropter & Im-[illegible, ~2 letters]perator res Priscum quidem sedat, eius vero loco re-[illegible, ~2 letters]mittit iterum Philippicum ducem. At miles etiam [illegible, ~2 letters]isti rebellat. & obsidetur fanè constantia à Persis, li-[illegible, ~2 letters]beratur autè à periculis, auxilio Germani. praelioq;

page.notes: The right margin is cut off by the scan edge. Only 1 to 3 letters of each marginal note survive, so each is marked illegible and placed approximately beside its line. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The word at the foot, "Perfas", is the catchword and is given under bottom_margin, not in the text. The chapter number "III." is a bare numeral and is therefore written as a paragraph, not a heading.
